commands.command: targeted Mach-O dSYM and ELF regression with -race

verifiedBehavior: A dSYM companion file selects __TEXT rather than the differently addressed file-backed __DWARF segment.
Mach-O DWARF resolves main to hello.c with a positive source line.
The HTTP Minidump path finds the uploaded dSYM by Debug ID when the module filename differs.
ELF and Debug-ID fallback regressions remain green.
